name: 13367 · Lowville, NY
findings: ZIP 13367 (Lowville) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13367 (Lowville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13367 (Lowville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
